INSERT INTO trade_routes 
    (route_id, name, time_start, time_end, nodes, materials, notes, sources, axis_id)
  VALUES
    ('TR_001', 'Route de l Encens - Arabie vers Méditerranée', -1500, 400, '[{"place": "Dhofar", "lat": 17.02, "lon": 54.09, "role": "source"}, {"place": "Petra", "lat": 30.33, "lon": 35.44, "role": "hub"}, {"place": "Gaza", "lat": 31.50, "lon": 34.47, "role": "port"}]', '["frankincense","myrrh","cinnamon"]', 'Route historique majeure pour les résines aromatiques', '["Herodotus","Pliny the Elder"]', 'AX2_ETHNOBOTANY_COMP'),
    ('TR_002', 'Route de la Soie - Segment Parfums', 200, 1400, '[{"place": "Kashgar", "lat": 39.47, "lon": 75.99, "role": "hub"}, {"place": "Samarkand", "lat": 39.65, "lon": 66.96, "role": "hub"}, {"place": "Constantinople", "lat": 41.01, "lon": 28.97, "role": "destination"}]', '["musk","sandalwood","camphor","aloeswood"]', 'Échanges de parfums et aromates sur la Route de la Soie', '["Marco Polo","Ibn Battuta"]', 'AX2_ETHNOBOTANY_COMP'),
    ('TR_003', 'Route Maritime des Épices', 1200, 1700, '[{"place": "Malacca", "lat": 2.19, "lon": 102.25, "role": "hub"}, {"place": "Calicut", "lat": 11.25, "lon": 75.77, "role": "port"}, {"place": "Aden", "lat": 12.78, "lon": 45.04, "role": "port"}, {"place": "Venice", "lat": 45.44, "lon": 12.32, "role": "destination"}]', '["cloves","nutmeg","benzoin","camphor"]', 'Route maritime pour les épices et aromates d Asie', '["Tome Pires","Duarte Barbosa"]', 'AX2_ETHNOBOTANY_COMP'),
    ('TR_004', 'Route du Mastic - Chios vers Empire Ottoman', 1500, 1900, '[{"place": "Chios", "lat": 38.37, "lon": 26.14, "role": "source"}, {"place": "Istanbul", "lat": 41.01, "lon": 28.97, "role": "destination"}, {"place": "Cairo", "lat": 30.04, "lon": 31.24, "role": "hub"}]', '["mastic","labdanum","storax"]', 'Commerce du mastic de Chios sous contrôle ottoman', '["Evliya Celebi"]', 'AX2_ETHNOBOTANY_COMP'),
    ('TR_005', 'Route Transatlantique des Baumes', 1550, 1800, '[{"place": "Cartagena", "lat": 10.39, "lon": -75.51, "role": "source"}, {"place": "Veracruz", "lat": 19.18, "lon": -96.14, "role": "port"}, {"place": "Seville", "lat": 37.39, "lon": -5.99, "role": "destination"}]', '["copaiba","peru_balsam","tolu_balsam","vanilla"]', 'Commerce colonial des baumes et résines américains', '["Monardes","Hernandez"]', 'AX2_ETHNOBOTANY_COMP'),
    ('TR_006', 'Route de la Myrrhe - Corne de l Afrique', -500, 1500, '[{"place": "Berbera", "lat": 10.44, "lon": 45.02, "role": "source"}, {"place": "Aden", "lat": 12.78, "lon": 45.04, "role": "hub"}, {"place": "Alexandria", "lat": 31.20, "lon": 29.92, "role": "destination"}]', '["myrrh","opopanax","bdellium"]', 'Commerce de la myrrhe depuis la Somalie', '["Periplus Maris Erythraei"]', 'AX2_ETHNOBOTANY_COMP')
  ON DUPLICATE KEY UPDATE
    name = VALUES(name),
    time_start = VALUES(time_start),
    time_end = VALUES(time_end),
    nodes = VALUES(nodes),
    materials = VALUES(materials),
    notes = VALUES(notes),
    sources = VALUES(sources);
